description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests for a Git subproject fetching and pushing workflow. It sets up repositories, commits files, clones repositories, updates repositories, and performs fetch operations, validating the repository states at each step.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function to define expected successful test steps, accepting a description and commands to execute.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: A function to simulate a timestamp tick or delay between commits.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: A function to compare expected and actual outputs, typically used for validation.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
